provenance.note: Legacy card sealed in safe deposit box 0005, not in the starting legacy deck. Same printed code as a deck card is a second copy the mod left in the box.

faces.transcription:
MISSION BRIEFING
"With Sabik gone, our focus can shift entirely to MEDUSA and the Soviets. We are close to understanding how the plague will be dispersed; Soviets are calling it Operation LION'S TOOTH, but we need more than just a name. A Soviet spy posing as a businessman, last seen in Sydney, has this information.
In addition, you must dig deeper into PEARL compound; locate and sabotage the MEDUSA manufacturing equipment."
Open the following doors:
U 39 42 S
